expectations.text: Groups universities into Reach, Match and Safety categories
Includes a comparison table with tuition, requirements and deadline columns
Includes a Sources section citing URLs or explicitly stating data is approximate and must be verified
expectations.evidence: Sources section with ~20 URLs plus an 'approximate, verify' note

expectations.text: Ends with concrete, numbered next steps
Every recommended option fits the ~$15k/yr budget, or the response explicitly says it depends on a scholarship
expectations.evidence: Each option is costed against $15k; Erasmus Mundus, Türkiye Burslari and GKS labelled fully funded; Saarland flagged as needing an IELTS retake

expectations.text: Names at least two specific fully or partly funded scholarships relevant to a Pakistani student (e.g. Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, GKS, MEXT, Türkiye Burslari, CSC)
expectations.evidence: Stipendium Hungaricum, Türkiye Burslari, Erasmus Mundus, GKS, DSU, Padua Excellence

expectations.text: Does not recommend Norway as a free-tuition option
